gloss: spring wage offensive; annual spring wage talks

definitions.gloss: spring wage offensive; annual spring labor negotiations
definitions.explanation: The wage negotiations that Japanese labor unions hold with employers each spring, coordinated across industries. The results, announced around March, set the tone for pay raises nationwide and are closely followed in the news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{春闘|しゅんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The spring wage talks have begun again this year.

examples.japanese: {春闘|しゅんとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賃上|ちんあ}げ→賃上げ：14256_chinage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: In the spring wage talks, major companies agreed to raise wages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{春闘|しゅんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}している→注目する：25530_chuumokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Because prices keep rising, many people are watching this year's spring wage talks closely.

notes:
Short for {春季闘争|しゅんきとうそう} (spring struggle). The word ⟦{闘争|とうそう}→闘争：14574_tousou⟧ reflects the term's origins in the postwar labor movement; today the talks are usually orderly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春闘|しゅんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧: management's reply in the spring talks
- {春闘|しゅんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: the outcome of the spring talks
- {春闘|しゅんとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賃上|ちんあ}げ→賃上げ：14256_chinage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to demand a raise in the spring talks
- {春闘|しゅんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集中回答日|しゅうちゅうかいとうび}: the day most big companies answer the unions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賃上|ちんあ}げ→賃上げ：14256_chinage⟧: wage increase — what the talks are about
- {労使交渉|ろうしこうしょう}: labor-management negotiations — the general term, at any time of year
